title: attachment.create_upload — Response
description: Returns the pending attachment record and an opaque upload_url the client MUST PUT the file bytes to before calling attachment.finalize. upload_url format is implementation-defined.

attachment.description: The newly created attachment in pending status.

upload_url.description: Opaque URL the client MUST PUT the raw file bytes to. May be a local server path or a presigned cloud storage URL.
